verdict.rationale: Figma documents first-party developer surfaces to build against: the Plugin API with read/write access to files, and an official repository with the OpenAPI specification and TypeScript types for the REST API. However, no evidence shows packaged, multi-language REST client SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec on the developer site. missing for 10: official REST client SDK libraries (e.g., JS/Python packages), multi-language SDK coverage, SDK usage docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: This repository contains the OpenAPI specification and Typescript types for the Figma REST API
The Plugin API supports both read and write access to Figma's editors, allowing developers to view, create, and modify the contents of files.
This guide helps you connect your React (or React Native) components with Figma components using Code Connect.
